lines.text: Who buys old frying oil? Never another kitchen.

lines.text: Let it cool, then pour it into a labelled can.

lines.text: Give it only to an authorised collector, and log it.

lines.text: Say a ₹2,000 van trip picks up one kitchen's 25 litres: ₹80 a litre.
